description_en: Retrieves a specific source address pool by its source address pool ID
description_zh: 根据源地址池ID获取单条源地址池信息
name: GetOriginPool

parameters.help_en: The origin pool ID. To get it, call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2863947.html
parameters.help_zh: 源地址池ID，可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2863947.html接口获取
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en: The site ID. To get it, call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html
parameters.name: site_id

Enabled.description_en:
Specifies if the origin pool is enabled.

true: The origin pool is enabled.

false: The origin pool is disabled
Enabled.description_zh:
源地址池是否启用：

true: 启用；
false：不启用

Name.description_en: The name of the origin pool. The name must be unique within a site
Name.description_zh: 源地址池名称，一个站点下源地址池名称唯一

Origins.description_en: The origins in the origin pool
Origins.description_zh: 源地址池里添加的源站信息

items.description_en: An origin in the origin pool
items.description_zh: 源地址池里添加的源站信息

Address.description_en: The origin address. For example, www.example.com

AuthConf.description_en: The authentication configuration. This parameter is required if the origin is an OSS or S3 bucket that requires authentication
AuthConf.description_zh: 鉴权信息，源站为OSS或者S3等源站需要鉴权时，需要传鉴权相关配置信息

AccessKey.description_en: The AccessKey ID. This parameter is required if `AuthType` is set to `private_cross_account` or `private`

AuthType.description_en:
The authentication type.

public: Public access. For OSS or S3 origins with public read access.

private_same_account: Private, same account. For private OSS origins in the same account.

private_cross_account: Private, cross-account. For private OSS origins in a different account.

private: Private. For private S3 origins
AuthType.description_zh:
鉴权类型。

public：公共读写，源站为OSS或S3且为公共读写时使用；
private_same_account：私有同账号，源站为OSS，且鉴权类型为同账号私有鉴权时使用；
private_cross_account：私有跨账号，源站为OSS，且鉴权类型为跨账号私有鉴权时使用；
private：源站为S3，且鉴权类型为私有时使用

Region.description_en: The AWS Region of the origin. Required if the origin is an AWS S3 bucket
Region.description_zh: 源站为AWS S3时需要传的源站Region

SecretKey.description_en: The AccessKey secret. This parameter is required if `AuthType` is set to `private_cross_account` or `private`

Version.description_en: The signature version. Required if the origin is an AWS S3 bucket
Version.description_zh: 源站为AWS S3时需要传的签名版本

Enabled.description_en:
Specifies if the origin is enabled.

true: The origin is enabled.

false: The origin is disabled
Enabled.description_zh:
源站是否启用：

true: 启用；
false：不启用

Header.description_en: The request header to include in origin requests. Only the Host header is supported
Header.description_zh: 回源时带的请求头，只支持Host

IpVersionPolicy.description_en:
The IP version policy for origin requests.

round_robin: Default policy. Routes requests to IPv4 and IPv6 origins on a round-robin basis.

ipv4_first: Prioritizes IPv4. Routes requests to IPv4 origins first.

ipv6_first: Prioritizes IPv6. Routes requests to IPv6 origins first.

follow: Matches the client's IP version. The origin request uses the same IP version as the incoming request
IpVersionPolicy.description_zh:
回源请求使用的 IP 协议版本：
round_robin：默认策略，随机轮询 IPv4 或 IPv6 源站
ipv4_first：优先使用 IPv4 源站
ipv6_first：优先使用 IPv6 源站
follow：优先跟随客户端使用的 IP 版本

Type.description_en:
The type of the origin.

ip_domain: An IP address or a domain name.

OSS: An OSS bucket.

S3: An AWS S3 bucket
Type.description_zh:
源站类型：

ip_domain: ip或域名类型源站；
OSS：OSS地址源站；
S3：AWS S3源站

Weight.description_en: The weight of the origin. Must be an integer from 0 to 100

RecordName.description_en: The domain name assigned to the origin pool. It serves as the origin address for records within the site
RecordName.description_zh: 为源地址池分配的域名，可以用来作站点下记录的源站地址

ReferenceLBCount.description_en: The number of load balancers that reference this origin pool
ReferenceLBCount.description_zh: 被多少个负载均衡器引用

References.description_en: Resources that reference the origin pool. An origin pool is referenced if a load balancer or record uses it as an origin
References.description_zh: 源地址池被引用信息，源地址池被负载均衡器配置或者被记录配置为源站时，被认为是引用

DnsRecords.description_en: The Layer 7 records that use this origin pool as their origin
DnsRecords.description_zh: 使用此源地址池为源站的七层记录列表

items.description_en: A Layer 7 record that uses this origin pool as its origin
items.description_zh: 使用此源地址池为源站的七层记录信息

IPARecords.description_en: The Layer 4 records that use this origin pool as their origin
IPARecords.description_zh: 使用此源地址池为源站的四层记录列表

items.description_en: A Layer 4 record that uses this origin pool as its origin
items.description_zh: 使用此源地址池为源站的四层记录信息

LoadBalancers.description_en: The load balancers that use this origin pool
LoadBalancers.description_zh: 使用此源地址池的负载均衡器列表

items.description_en: A load balancer that uses this origin pool
items.description_zh: 使用此源地址池的负载均衡器信息

Id.description_en: The ID of the load balancer

Name.description_en: The name of the load balancer

SiteId.description_en: The ID of the site that contains the origin pool
